David Kowitz decreased its stake in Icici Bk Ltd (IBN) by 30.23% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by David Kowitz held 4.01M shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $35.53M, down from 5.75M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Indus Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Icici Bk Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $28.96 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.68% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $8.83. About 5.43 million shares traded.
